_doc: Shrink-only allowlist of hand-rolled candle merging that pre-dates CH-timeframe-ssot-v1 (census 2026-10-09). Enforced by tests/test_aggregation_authority.py: a new hit fails; a removed hit must be deleted or lowered here. Never add an entry to make a new merge pass: call the authority.

authority.grids: features.calendar_periods (HOUR_GRID_HOURS, BAR_MINUTES) with the corpus calendar (corpus.calendar)
authority.scanner_limits: Syntax only (pandas resample/floor with a time-rule literal, pd.Grouper(freq=), groupby on a .dt.date/.dt.normalize() key). Scope src/, scripts/, tools/ excluding archive/ and tests/. Hand-rolled merging elsewhere (e.g. userinvestigation/) and index arithmetic like hour // 4 are not detected.

entries.reason: Research: N-hour blocks via an epoch-anchored UTC floor (naive, not the 17:00 New York grid). Duplicated under archive/. Migrate to research.resample when next touched.
